name: diag_additional_look_budget_01
command:
import pathlib,json,importlib.util
from src.tools.t01_partition import audited_result,sha_file
r=pathlib.Path.cwd();p=r/'logs/review/diag_additional_look_export_plan_01/additional_look_plan.json';assert sha_file(p)=='1d45782b593643f3a122af3f82d2ac65aaa087bd23b5c2bc8b9a242130b41167'
d=json.loads(p.read_text());logged,ref=audited_result(r/'results/diag_additional_look_export_plan_01.json')
assert logged['_meta']['exit_code']==0 and d['ready_after_CPU_preflight'] and d['errors']==[] and d['additional_Look_count']==14
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('phase',r/'scripts/pbs/submit_phase.py');phase=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(phase);b=phase.budget_state(r)
requested=sum(g['wall_seconds']*g['gpus']/3600 for g in d['groups'])
assert b['accounted_or_reserved_by_subbudget']['T01v2']+requested<=16 and b['accounted_or_reserved_total']+requested<=60
print('ADDITIONAL_LOOK_BUDGET_JSON: '+json.dumps({'plan':{'file':str(p.relative_to(r)),'sha256':sha_file(p)},'logged_plan':ref,'budget_before':b['accounted_or_reserved_by_subbudget'],'total_before':b['accounted_or_reserved_total'],'requested_upper':requested,'after_T01v2':b['accounted_or_reserved_by_subbudget']['T01v2']+requested},sort_keys=True))
with (r/'STATUS.md').open('a') as f:f.write('\nAdditional frozen Look export batch: all14 original G01 inputs passed actual authenticated T02 source loading (diag_additional_look_export_plan_01), with unchanged scientific checks. Inventory01 fixes31 unique Look; original17 and later14 are disjoint by proposal identity. Original exporter will diagnose the14 in6/7/1 groups, each worker600s, oneGPU per job, unchanged D4/255px/60degree rules. Additional ceilings total '+str(requested)+'GPUh; T01v2 actual/reserved plus all three new ceilings is '+str(b['accounted_or_reserved_by_subbudget']['T01v2']+requested)+'/16. Source plan is frozen before submitting; no cache/training approval inferred.\n')
